## Outcome
Run bounded issue workers with branch, path, push, pull-request, and repair guards.

## Scope
Read:
- T050 issue identities
- Dependency-ready WorkGraph items
- Owned branch and pull-request state

Write:
- T060-approved worker, branch, PR, repair, receipt, contract, and test files
- Board-owned branches and pull requests in github.com/Vel-Labs/orcastrata-max

## Non-goals
- Merge authority
- Force push
- Schedules
- Shared branch ownership

## Acceptance criteria
- Disjoint workers produce reviewable pull requests without scope or merge violations.

## Validation
- `VAL-T060` — Run packet, lease, path, branch, PR-state, failure-routing, package, and dogfood checks. → All selected checks pass.

## Dependencies
- T050

## Stop condition
Stop on path overlap, branch drift, force push, dependency change, or a repeated failure signature.

## Orcastrata state
- Work item: `T060`
- GoalBuddy status: `queued`
